name: Phitsanulok

queries.query: Phitsanulok Thailand official cadastral parcel map GIS public service Department of Lands
queries.result: First-party discovery found the Department of Lands Landmap/land-parcel information center, the current LandsPublic viewer, and the official Phitsanulok Provincial Land Office. The current viewer is a public-land (NSL) map service rather than evidence of a complete private cadastral parcel service.

queries.query: พิษณุโลก แผนที่แปลงที่ดิน กรมที่ดิน ระบบค้นหารูปแปลงที่ดิน
queries.result: แหล่งทางการพบศูนย์ข้อมูลแผนที่รูปแปลงที่ดินของกรมที่ดิน ระบบ LandsPublic และสำนักงานที่ดินจังหวัดพิษณุโลก ระบบ LandsPublic ปัจจุบันเปิดชั้นข้อมูล น.ส.ล. (ที่สาธารณประโยชน์) และขอบเขตการปกครอง ไม่ใช่หลักฐานว่ามีข้อมูลแปลงกรรมสิทธิ์เอกชนแบบสาธารณะครบถ้วน.

registryEvidence.custodian: The Department of Lands is the evidenced national custodian of the Landmap/LandsPublic service, and the Phitsanulok Provincial Land Office is the evidenced local DOL office. No public anonymous private-parcel registry/API was qualified.
registryEvidence.scope: The official local office page establishes the provincial office and its public service role. The LandsPublic viewer exposes a public-land NSL service, not a complete city cadastral registry. registryFound remains null.

parcelDiscovery.source: Current official DOL LandsPublic viewer and its exposed public API/WFS were checked; no safe parcel polygon was returned for the bounded Phitsanulok request.
parcelDiscovery.crs: EPSG:4326 declared by WFS capabilities for LPCPUBLIC:DOLNSL; no retained geometry

attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP 200 official DOL Landmap center page; it links public-land and related map services but did not expose a private parcel-vector endpoint in the page itself.
HTTP 200 current official LandsPublic viewer. JavaScript configuration exposed the anonymous NSL point API, DOLNSL TMS layer, and LPCPUBLIC WFS/WMS service.
With ordinary browser User-Agent and official viewer Referer, HTTP 404 JSON: No data found at this location. This exact-point miss was not treated as citywide absence.
HTTP 200 WFS capabilities. LPCPUBLIC:DOLNSL is titled public-land (NSL), declares EPSG:4326, and exposes only public-land attributes including nsl_id; no private cadastral parcel layer was evidenced.
HTTP 200 schema. Native fields include geom, nsl_id, nsl_id_e, nsl_name, administrative names, and responsible organization. No feature was retained.
HTTP 200 bounded anonymous response: empty FeatureCollection, totalFeatures 0. This is a bounded public-land-layer result only, not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
HTTP 200 official Phitsanulok Provincial Land Office page; local office identity and service context confirmed, but no anonymous parcel geometry/API was exposed.

parcelDiscovery.note: The exact WUP point was preserved and never shifted. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, unsafe-field request, or TLS exception was used.

uncertainty: The official viewer is demonstrably a public-land NSL service; it does not establish public access to the complete private cadastral parcel fabric.
The exact point miss, bounded empty response, and unavailable legacy DOLWMS host are limited route outcomes and are not citywide absence evidence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
No sample GeoJSON was written because no safe native parcel identity plus full polygon was returned.
Packet completion is not source integration or runtime admission.
